exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.description: Classic bodyweight press. Keep your body in one straight line.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.description: Controlled squat with a stable torso and knees tracking over the feet.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.description: Drive through the feet and squeeze the glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: Brace the trunk and keep hips neither sagging nor excessively raised.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.description: Slow alternating limb movement while maintaining a braced trunk.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.description: Step back under control and drive through the front foot.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.description: Controlled opposite-arm/opposite-leg extension with a stable pelvis.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.description: Dynamic plank movement. Keep the trunk controlled as pace increases.
